name: Zacchaeus
bio: Zacchaeus, a wealthy chief tax collector in Jericho, climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus over the crowd because he was too short to see otherwise. Jesus called him down and announced he would stay at his house, drawing criticism for associating with a sinner; Zacchaeus received him joyfully and pledged to give half his goods to the poor and repay fourfold anyone he had defrauded. Jesus declared that salvation had come to his house, since he too was a son of Abraham, and that he had come to seek and save the lost (Luke 19:1-10).
